context.content_translation:
由于他对历史建筑的了解，Luis Harmon 被说服担任 Main Street 修复项目负责人。
A. 说服
B. 有说服力地
C. 被说服
D. 说服人

items.question: Owing to his knowledge of historic buildings, Luis Harmon was ------- to lead the Main Street Restoration Project.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“persuaded”代入题干后为“Owing to his knowledge of historic buildings, Luis Harmon was persuaded to lead the Main Street Restoration Project.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：C（persuaded）。
